content.title: 9-1-4-1. Alteration of nonconforming signs.
content.summary:
A.	Generally. Nonconforming signs may be altered as provided in this Section, except that this Section does not apply to signs within the OT zoning district (see Section 6-1-7-2, Historic Signs; Exceptions to Nonconformity and Abandonment).
B.	Limitations on Alterations.

faqs.a:
A.	Generally. Nonconforming signs may be altered as provided in this Section, except that this Section does not apply to signs within the OT zoning district (see Section 6-1-7-2, Historic Signs; Exceptions to Nonconformity and Abandonment).
B.	Limitations on Alterations. Nonconforming signs may be altered as follows:
  1.	Except for Certificate of Compliance to the Design Guidelines, the copy of a nonconforming sign may be changed without limitation, provided that the sign area, sign height, background shape, and location of the sign are not changed.
